global.title: Thursday briefing: Why young people are having less sex than ever
global.summary: In today’s newsletter: A new study of sexual trends in Britain has found that one in three under-25s have never had sex, a flashy headline that obscures the real reasons behind a ‘sex recession’ among young people Good morning. Let’s talk about sex! I know, I know; it’s not 9am yet. But trust me, you’ll enjoy it and I won’t ask you to do anything that puts your back out before your first brew. The National Survey of Sexual Attitudes and Lifestyles, or Natsal, is a big-deal publication: a substantial piece of research capturing trends in British intimacy every decade since 1990. This week, it made more headlines than usual with the revelation that sex among adults of all genders and sexualities has slumped – and the standout finding that one in three under-25s report they have never had sexual intercourse. items.summaryZh: 瑞银预测，随着中国加强技术自立，国内AI加速器出货量将在2025年至2030年间增长近六倍。寒武纪和壁仞科技等本土企业正成为市场领跑者，这将进一步挤压英伟达的市场空间。

items.title: FedEx plane overshoots Miami runway, causing brief suspension of flights at airport
items.summary: A FedEx cargo plane overran a runway at Miami International Airport on Wednesday night, forcing all but one runway to temporarily close the day before Thanksgiving, according to officials. There were no reports of injuries after the plane ran off the runway at about 8.40pm, the airport reported. items.titleZh: 联邦快递飞机在迈阿密冲出跑道，机场航班短暂暂停
items.summaryZh: 一架联邦快递货机周三晚在迈阿密国际机场冲出跑道，导致机场大部分跑道临时关闭。目前未收到人员伤亡报告，联邦航空管理局已介入调查。
items.whyImportant: 航空安全事故的频发引发了公众对机场运营安全和货运物流风险的关注。

items.title: Colombian president taunts arrested supermarket hostage-takers
items.summary: Colombia’s president has confronted the men who held 76 people hostage at a Cartagena supermarket.
